title: Labor Rate and Missed Visit Credit Rate Sheet for the Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs
content:
Rate sheet of the billing office for air quality work beyond the included content of the Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs, and for the credit rate and grace period that attach to a scheduled visit the company fails to perform.

| Tier | Labor rate for air quality work beyond the included content (USD per hour) | Multiplier on the labor rate for work outside regular hours | Credit of the per-visit value where the company misses a scheduled filter or service visit (percent) | Business days after the scheduled day within which a moved visit is not a missed visit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Filter Supply Program | 158 | 1.5 | 0 | 0 |
| Managed Filtration Program | 152 | 1.5 | 100 | 5 |
| Coil Hygiene Program | 146 | 1.5 | 100 | 5 |
| Air Quality Monitoring Program | 142 | 1.5 | 100 | 3 |
| UV & Purification Service Program | 138 | 1.25 | 100 | 3 |
| Certified Indoor Air Quality Program | 132 | 1.25 | 150 | 2 |

### After-hours rate, in words

The after-hours rate at a tier is the tier's labor rate multiplied by the tier's after-hours multiplier. On the sheet above that gives, per hour, 237 USD at the Filter Supply Program (158 multiplied by 1.5), 228 USD at the Managed Filtration Program (152 multiplied by 1.5), 219 USD at the Coil Hygiene Program (146 multiplied by 1.5), 213 USD at the Air Quality Monitoring Program (142 multiplied by 1.5), 172.50 USD at the UV & Purification Service Program (138 multiplied by 1.25) and 165 USD at the Certified Indoor Air Quality Program (132 multiplied by 1.25).

### Credit rate and grace period

- A credit rate of 0 percent, as at the Filter Supply Program, is a credit of nothing; a rate of 100 percent is a credit of the whole per-visit value; the rate of 150 percent at the Certified Indoor Air Quality Program is a credit of one and a half times the per-visit value.
- The grace period is counted in business days after the scheduled day: 5 at the Managed Filtration Program and the Coil Hygiene Program, 3 at the Air Quality Monitoring Program and the UV & Purification Service Program, 2 at the Certified Indoor Air Quality Program, and 0 at the Filter Supply Program.
